summary: Focused headless e2e coverage passes, and headed Electron visual verification now proves the user-visible Settings behavior: in a session launched with KEPLER_INSTANCE=dev-visual and KOSMOS_DATA_DIR=.tmp/settings-open-verify-data, with no KOSMOS_HEADLESS/KOSMOS_TEST_MODE, `window.kepler.commands.invoke("settings:open")` opens Settings visible/focused, restores+focuses after minimize, and shows+focuses after hide.

commands.command: set KOSMOS_HEADLESS=1 && rtk bunx playwright test --config platform/desktop/playwright.config.ts platform/desktop/e2e/tests/e2e/headless-window-repeat-open.spec.ts
commands.result: 1 test passed; the spec exercises both `window.kepler.commands.invoke('settings:open')` and `window.kepler.settings.open()` and keeps the Settings window count at 1.

commands.command: headed Electron visual verification with KEPLER_INSTANCE=dev-visual, KOSMOS_DATA_DIR=.tmp/settings-open-verify-data, no KOSMOS_HEADLESS/KOSMOS_TEST_MODE; invoked window.kepler.commands.invoke("settings:open")
commands.result: Settings opens visible/focused, restores+focuses after minimize, and shows+focuses after hide. Evidence: `.tmp/logs/settings-open-verify.log`, `.tmp/visual/2026-06-16-settings-open-verify/settings-after-first-command.png`, `.tmp/visual/2026-06-16-settings-open-verify/settings-after-refocus-from-minimized.png`, `.tmp/visual/2026-06-16-settings-open-verify/settings-after-refocus-from-hidden.png`.

notes: `platform/desktop/electron/settings-window.ts` adds `restore()` and `show()` before `focus()` when reusing an existing Settings window.
The new focused e2e coverage lives at `platform/desktop/e2e/tests/e2e/headless-window-repeat-open.spec.ts`.

acceptance_criteria.reason: Headed Electron visual verification confirmed the current UI command path opens Settings visible/focused, restores+focuses from minimized, and shows+focuses from hidden. Evidence: `.tmp/logs/settings-open-verify.log` and screenshots under `.tmp/visual/2026-06-16-settings-open-verify/`.
The updated e2e explicitly invokes `window.kepler.commands.invoke('settings:open')` and verifies one Settings window exists.
The updated e2e explicitly invokes `window.kepler.settings.open()` after the command-bus path and still verifies one Settings window exists.
Repeated open calls remain single-window safe in headless mode; the existing Settings window count stays at 1 and no visible windows appear in headless/test mode.
Current code changes are limited to the focused Settings-window reuse logic plus the new targeted e2e coverage; no unrelated command-bus or ARK changes were found.
